grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 44721 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so every source row is already a distinct invoice line event and the fact is declared at transaction grain. No single column is unique on its own (invoice_id has distinct_count 2330, stock_code 3141, invoiced_at 2004), so a derived identity over the tuple (invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, unit_price) identifies a line; with zero exact duplicates in the source this tuple has nothing to absorb and no aggregation is required.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice document identifier with null_rate 0.0 and samples like '489434' and '489435'; a numeric-looking code stored as VARCHAR that labels the invoice a line belongs to, so it is a dimension rather than a measure.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Boolean flag with exactly two distinct values (false, true) and null_rate 0.0 marking whether the line belongs to a cancellation, consistent with the negative quantities observed in the quantity samples.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code with null_rate 0.0 and 3141 distinct values such as '10002' and '10123C'; an alphanumeric product identifier, so a dimension.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '11 PC CERAMIC TEA SET POLKADOT'; nullable with null_rate 0.005098 (228 nulls), likely missing where the catalog carries no description for a stock code.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units sold on the line with null_rate 0.0, ranging from -1395 to 5184; negative samples correspond to cancellation lines, and the value is summed and compared across rows, so it is a measure.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Invoice timestamp with null_rate 0.0 spanning 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00; samples resolve to the minute (seconds are always :00), timestamping each line event.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit with null_rate 0.0, ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49; a monetary amount compared and aggregated across rows, so a measure, with zero-price samples present in the data.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier (samples 12346 to 12437, 1045 distinct values) that labels rather than measures, so a dimension; nullable with null_rate 0.300664 (13446 nulls), consistent with guest or unregistered purchases carrying no customer.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country with null_rate 0.0 and 24 distinct values such as 'Australia' and 'EIRE', labeling where the invoice was placed.

category_description: One row is one invoice line: a single product (stock_code) sold or cancelled in a given quantity at a given unit price on one invoice (invoice_id) at a specific minute (invoiced_at), optionally tied to a customer and always tied to a country.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category: its transaction grain, its derived line identity, its minute-grained time column, and the dimension/measure role of every mapped column. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which renders the gold models from it.
usage: The proposal is rendered by deterministic code into an ODCS mapping contract draft (gold_invoice_lines_mapping), validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; nothing in it executes directly.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or transform rows: cancellation lines (is_cancellation = true, with negative quantities down to -1395) and zero-priced lines (unit_price min 0.0) are mapped as-is, and their exclusion is left to consumers. It does not resolve the 30.07% null customer_id rows to any surrogate customer, does not declare quality rules, severities, classifications, service levels, ownership, or access policies, and derives no columns beyond the line_identity the transaction grain requires.
